findings.title: holdOwnDraft still ignores a file-only draft, so Enter can be dropped in the receipt-pending window
findings.body: This PR makes Enter on a file-only box count as a new message when a send is in flight (line 1775, `textRef.current.trim() || nextDraftHasFiles()`). The sibling path `holdOwnDraft` (line 1831) still returns false unless there is text. `performSubmit` calls it at line 1850 when the previous send was accepted but its receipt has not been applied yet (`beginChatComposerMutation` returned no token and nothing is pending). A file-only Enter pressed in that one-commit window is silently dropped. The same Enter with text would be held and sent. Is the asymmetry intended? If not, `holdOwnDraft` could use the same `textRef.current.trim() || nextDraftHasFiles()` test. The user can press Enter again, so the cost is small.

findings.title: Restore wait now runs before the wire conversion, so a restore that starts during it is not awaited
findings.body: The old code awaited the in-flight restore after `toWireAttachments`, right before the POST. The new code awaits it once, before `toWireAttachments` (lines 2428-2432). The wait is skipped when no restore is tracked at call time. If a restore starts while `toWireAttachments` is reading or uploading a large file, for example from the Restore button or another window, the POST at line 2433 goes to the archived session before its worktree is back. That is the case the old order covered. Moving the wait before the wire step does keep a large upload from starting early. Awaiting `restoreInFlight` a second time just before the POST would cover both orders.

findings.title: Comment explaining the archived-session stager gate was deleted
findings.body: The only change in this file is deleting the two-line comment above `onStageAttachments`. The condition on line 953 is unchanged. The comment said why the stager is offered only while the session is active or `commands.resumingAgent` is true: the worktree is gone until the restore runs. Nothing in the PR makes that explanation untrue, and the gate is easy to misread without it. The PR body also lists a gate change in this file as part of the fix, but this diff has none. Please keep the comment, or say in the PR which commit changed the gate.
